infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MTS Agent needs your location to track your deliveries and assign you nearby jobs.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: MTS Agent needs your location in the background to track active deliveries even when the app is minimized.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: MTS Agent needs your location at all times to ensure accurate delivery tracking.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MTS Agent needs camera access to scan QR codes and take proof-of-delivery photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MTS Agent needs photo library access to upload proof-of-delivery images.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: MTS Agent needs to send you notifications for new delivery assignments and updates.
